sourceChecks.note: MB&F's official HM12 page was checked on 2026-09-03 and confirms the The Guardian Green edition, Grade 5 titanium family construction, current CHF price, 84-hour automatic movement, and the HM12 design. MB&F does not publish a separate per-colour manufacturer SKU on the page.
The authorized retailer page correlates the Green edition with reference 12.TL.GR; this is retained as dealer-correlated reference evidence, not as an MB&F manufacturer SKU.
The technical article corroborates the 49.3 x 43.6 x 13.8 mm case, 20 mm strap interface, and Velcro quick-release strap.

additionalVerifiedFacts.note: The official page lists CHF 280,000 excluding taxes; the value is normalized to minor currency units.
The official product page quotes the price in CHF.
The HM12 technical description identifies the Grade 5 titanium case construction.
The corroborating technical specification lists 43.6 mm case width.
The corroborating technical specification lists 49.3 mm case length.
The corroborating technical specification lists 13.8 mm case height.
The technical specification lists a 20 mm strap/lug interface.
The HM12 is described as an automatic mechanical horological machine.

The technical summary gives 30 m water resistance.
The HM12 uses a Velcro strap with a quick-release system for mounting on the Guardian.
